errors.text: The proposed material system, substrate, coating geometry, and experimental method differ fundamentally from the FeNiCrCoCu/Cu atomistic nanoindentation-friction system.
The proposed degradation boundary of 450–550 K conflicts with the target threshold near 900 K.

The twinning and oxide-instability mechanism is not the target mechanism, which is governed by lattice disorder, declining dislocation density, lattice softening, and a stacking-fault-to-disorder transition.
The tested temperature range ends at 600 K and therefore cannot detect the target's sharp degradation at 900–1200 K.
The cited evidence does not substantiate the claimed temperature-dependent oxide failure boundary or the predicted intermediate-temperature wear maximum.
